description: Validate URLs by making HEAD requests and checking HTTP status codes. Returns categorization: working (200), browser_only (401/403/407 from bot-blocking sites that work in browsers), broken (404/410), or timeout/error. ALWAYS use this before presenting reference links to users — broken links destroy trust. Pass all URLs you plan to cite.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout per URL in ms (default 10000, max 30000)

name: utils.validate_links
